changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Convert partnerInformation from single JSON object to JSON array for records that are not already arrays
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_anc SET partner_information = jsonb_build_array(partner_information) WHERE partner_information IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(partner_information) = 'object';

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add partnerId (UUID) to each partner in the partnerInformation array that does not have one
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_anc SET partner_information = ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN elem->>'partnerId' IS NULL OR elem->>'partnerId' = '' THEN elem || jsonb_build_object('partnerId', gen_random_uuid()::text) ELSE elem END ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(partner_information) AS elem ) WHERE partner_information IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(partner_information) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(partner_information) > 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(partner_information) AS el WHERE el->>'partnerId' IS NULL OR el->>'partnerId' = '' );
